meta.source: arionbanki.is stylesheets (Oct 2026) mapped onto shadcn-templ v2 theme variables

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page canvas (Arion body background). `bg-background`.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default text on `background`, `card`, `popover` and `muted` (Arion body navy). 12.6:1 light, 15.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card, table container and form panel surface. `bg-card`.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Dropdown, select, dialog and toast surface.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Arion blue: the one action colour. Default button, links, active nav, checked controls, slider range. Light value is Arion's theme-color; dark is a lifted blue.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` (6.7:1 light, 6.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Quiet button fill (`VariantSecondary`), secondary badges.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary` (13.7:1 / 11.2:1).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Tracks, tab list background, skeletons, pressed toggles. Between Arion's #f3f5f6 and #e6ecef so it reads on the `background` canvas.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Descriptions, helper text, placeholders, table captions on `background`, `card`, `muted`. Darkened from Arion's #5e7788 (4.3:1) to clear 4.5:1 on `muted` (4.9:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and highlighted row in menus, ghost buttons, sidebar active item. Light = Arion blue at 12% over white; dark = Arion's hover navy #223c52.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent` (5.6:1 light, 9.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions, negative figures (always with a minus sign or icon). 5.9:1 on white; on its own 10% tint (nova destructive button) 4.6:1 on `background` and 4.9:1 on `card`. Darkened from Arion's #d70000, which falls to 4.27:1 on the canvas. Dark #ff7a70 clears 4.5:1 on the 20% tint nova uses for destructive badges in dark mode.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `destructive` fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card dividers, table rows, separators. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Control borders (input, select, checkbox, radio) and the unchecked switch track. 3.3:1 on `background`, 3.5:1 on white (WCAG 1.4.11 needs 3:1); dark 3.5:1. Arion's own outlined-control border (50% navy) is 2.9:1, so this is a solid, slightly darker slate.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus: shadcn draws `border-ring` (solid, 6.7:1) plus a 3px `ring/50` halo. Keep both.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First series: Arion blue.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series: Arion gold (from its financial tables).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series: Arion plum.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series: Arion slate. Dark value is darker than `chart-3` so the two stay apart for deuteranopes.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth series / remainder: light slate (light, 3.1:1 on `card`), sand (dark). Label it directly.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar surface.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar`.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Sidebar brand tile and primary item.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-primary`.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Active and hovered sidebar item (Arion's active-nav pill).

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-accent`.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Sidebar edge and separators.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: shadcn-templ extra: code blocks and inset panels.

tokens.name: surface-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `surface`.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection; Arion's focus-visible fill in light, a mid blue in dark so it separates from `card` (2.3:1) while keeping `selection-foreground` at 6:1.

tokens.name: selection-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `selection` (10.7:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Arion's dark contained button (e.g. its 'Afkomukynning' CTA). Use via `Class: "bg-ink text-ink-foreground hover:bg-ink-hover"` for a single editorial CTA, never beside a `primary` button.

tokens.name: ink-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `ink` (16.3:1).

tokens.name: ink-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for `ink` buttons (Arion's hover navy).

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Strong secondary text, table group headers on `card`.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Arion gold: highlight figures, chart-2. Text-safe on white (5.1:1) and on `card` dark (7.0:1).

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Arion plum: rare accent, chart-3.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Warm band behind editorial blocks and report covers.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Intentional addition: gains, healthy status. Teal leaves the red-green axis so it reads apart from `destructive`; still pair with + or an up arrow.

tokens.name: positive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `positive` fill (5.6:1 light, 7.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Intentional addition: in-progress, degraded and caution states. Amber-brown text is safe on `card` (6.3:1), `background` (6.0:1) and its own 10% tint (5.2:1); dark 8.7:1 on `card`. Pair with an icon or word.

tokens.name: warning-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `warning` fill (6.3:1 light, 9.8:1 dark).

families.sans: "Hanken Grotesk", "Hanken Grotesk Fallback", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: "Source Serif 4", "Source Serif 4 Fallback", ui-serif, Georgia, serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", "JetBrains Mono Fallback", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page: marketing hero, report cover. Arion's 5rem serif hero.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Page title on dashboards and docs (Arion 2.5rem).

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: App page title when the serif display is too loud.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card group heading, dialog title on wide dialogs.

styles.name: heading-4
styles.usage: Card title (shadcn CardTitle is 16px/medium in nova).

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Markmið Arion banka er að veita tímanlegar upplýsingar.
styles.usage: Lead paragraph under a display title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Promote the release to production after the canary passes.
styles.usage: Reading text: docs, long descriptions (Arion body 16px).

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: UI text: shadcn components default to text-sm.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, button text, table headers.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Amounts and metrics in tables: set `tabular-nums`, right-align.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code, commit SHAs, image tags, IDs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside buttons and badges (Tailwind 1).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; button group spacing (Tailwind 2).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card spacing in `data-size=sm` cards; field label to input (Tailwind 3).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (`--card-spacing`), form field gap (Tailwind 4).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid (Tailwind 6).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside a page (Tailwind 8).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top padding, space above a display title (Tailwind 12).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero and report-cover padding (Tailwind 16).

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: shadcn `--radius` base (8px, Arion's dominant radius). `rounded-lg`.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges inside tables, kbd, checkbox (Arion 4px). `rounded-sm`.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small buttons, menu items. `rounded-md`.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, alerts. `rounded-lg`.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, popovers (Arion 10px panels). `rounded-xl`.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: badges, avatars, switches.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards when a ring is not enough.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Popovers, dropdowns, select content.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs and toasts (Arion's largest shadow).
